meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 它把 Matrix 适配器从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/、加一行注册导入、安装 @beeper/chat-adapter-matrix@0.2.0 并修补其 ESM 导入，再构建并跑注册测试；还会带你创建独立的机器人账号并写入凭据。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Matrix 频道时触发——主干不自带频道，适配器需从 channels 分支复制；装好后可用 /manage-channels 把频道接到 agent group。

say.text: 帮我接入 Matrix 频道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖、构建并跑测试。

say.text: 用访问令牌方式配置 Matrix 机器人凭据
say.note: 会依次询问令牌、用户 ID 和显示名。
重跑 ESM 补丁后再构建。

howto.what_en: Copies the Matrix adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, adds a registration import, installs and patches @beeper/chat-adapter-matrix@0.2.0, then builds and runs the registration test. Also sets up bot credentials.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a Matrix channel to NanoClaw — channels don't ship in trunk, so the adapter is copied from the channels branch. Afterwards, /manage-channels wires it to an agent group.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds and tests.

say_en.text: Set up the Matrix bot with an access token
say_en.note: Prompts for token, user ID and display name.
Re-run the ESM patch, then build.
